description.zh:
是否倒序：

- true（默认）：是
- false：否
description.en:
Specifies whether to sort in descending order. Valid values:

- true (default): Yes.
- false: No.

description.zh:
返回结果按照哪个字段排序，可选值如下：

- event_time：事件创建时间
- event_execute_start_time：事件执行时间
- event_execute_finish_time：事件完成时间
description.en:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:

- event_time: event creation time
- event_execute_start_time: event execution time
- event_execute_finish_time: event completion time.

description.zh: 按照事件创建时间查询，结束时间。采用时间戳形式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time for querying by event creation time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 按照事件创建时间查询，起始时间。采用时间戳形式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time for querying by event creation time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 事件的生命周期状态对象。
description.en: The lifecycle status of the event.

description.zh: 按照事件执行时间查询，结束时间。采用时间戳形式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time for querying by event execution time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 按照事件执行时间查询，起始时间。采用时间戳形式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time for querying by event execution time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 按照事件完成时间查询，结束时间。采用时间戳形式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time for querying by event completion time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 按照事件完成时间查询，起始时间。采用时间戳形式，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time for querying by event completion time. Specify a timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 触发事件的节点的IP地址。
description.en: The IP address of the node that triggered the event.

description.zh: 起始文档偏移量。需要为非负数，默认为0。
description.en: The starting document offset. The value must be a non-negative integer. Default value: 0.

description.zh: 要返回的事件数量。需要为非负数，默认为10。
description.en: The number of events to return. The value must be a non-negative integer. Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch list-instance-history-events --instance-id es-cn-2r42l7a7400050000 --node-ip 10.1.xx.xx --event-type Instance:InstanceFailure.Reboot:Executed --event-level INFO,WARN --event-create-start-time 1645596516000 --event-create-end-time 1645596516000 --event-execute-start-time 1645596516000 --event-execute-end-time 1645596516000 --event-finash-start-time 1645596516000 --event-finash-end-time 1645596516000 --page 0 --size 10 --event-cycle-status EXECUTED,FAILED --biz-body sortField=event_time desc=true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
